import re

def masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    """The text with the skill's own name and its parts replaced, lower-cased."""
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

import random
import string
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import re

# load refactored module
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', '/work/textmask.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# original behavior for equivalence check
def masked_orig(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\\b", "x", t)
    return t

# deterministic cases
cases = [
    ('Hello Fowler Refactoring', 'fowler-refactoring'),
    ('abc def ghi', 'ab-c'),
    ('XxX alpha-beta alpha beta', 'alpha-beta'),
    ('name-with--double--dash', 'name-with--double--dash'),
    ('special a+b a+b-c', 'a+b-c'),
    ('MiXeD CaSe', 'Mixed-Case'),
    ('', ''),
]

for text, name in cases:
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    o = masked_orig(text, name)
    assert n == o, (text, name, n, o)

# randomized cases
chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '-_+ .'
for _ in range(500):
    text = ''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 80)))
    name = ''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 25)))
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    o = masked_orig(text, name)
    if n != o:
        raise AssertionError((text, name, n, o))

# token check
name = 'aa-bbbb-ccc-bbbb'
expected = sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True)
assert mod.name_tokens(name) == expected

print('OK: refactor preserved masked behavior and name_tokens sorting semantics.')
